nodes.value: Separate diagnosis from repair and report evidence for every finding.
Support machine-readable output for automation and runbooks.
Self-diagnosis is advisory and cannot self-certify production health.
Correlate component reports with external telemetry/checks.
Repair plan declares affected state and rollback before mutation.
Post-repair verification must prove targeted invariant restoration.
Twin state records freshness/uncertainty and never authorizes real effects.
Synchronize from governed observations, not inferred model text alone.
Plans respect compatibility, blast radius, SLO and resource constraints.
Planner output remains proposal until deployment policy authorizes.
Admission must reserve bounded resources before work starts.
Scheduler handles preemption/recovery without losing ownership.
Track wait age/tenant/share and apply bounded anti-starvation policy.
Fairness must not override security or hard safety constraints.
Every unbounded producer/consumer boundary must define pressure semantics.
Cancellation/degradation behavior remains explicit under pressure.
Define shed priority/class and response semantics.
Never shed required security/audit/authority operations silently.
Measure depth/age/service rate and enforce queue budgets.
Congestion policy differentiates new work, retries and recovery work.
Retry only classified transient failures with idempotency safety.
Shared budget prevents nested layers multiplying attempts.
Breaker state is scoped per dependency/failure domain.
Define concurrency/resource pools by critical domain.
Cross-bulkhead fallback requires explicit capacity/authority policy.
DLQ entries preserve original identity, attempts and failure cause.
Replay requires current authorization/idempotency and compatibility checks.
Replay distinguishes read-only reconstruction, simulation and real side-effect retry.
External effects require reconciliation/idempotency before re-execution.
Tests use appropriate equivalence/tolerance for each determinism class.
Nondeterminism sources are recorded in reproducibility evidence.
Never use wall clock for elapsed-duration correctness.
Represent timezone/calendar semantics explicitly at boundaries.
IDs never encode mutable/display-sensitive authority data.
Never infer causality solely from timestamps.
Control plane orchestrates only through canonical contracts and independent policy gates.
Its durable state is explicit, recoverable and auditable.
Distinguish requested objective from inferred subgoals.
Ambiguous high-impact objectives require clarification or bounded alternative.
Hard constraints cannot be traded away by utility scoring.
Constraint provenance and conflicts are explicit.
Decision process separates admissibility from preference optimization.
Record evidence/options/criteria and uncertainty for consequential choices.
Decision records are immutable; corrections/supersession append new nodes.
IR includes dependencies, inputs/outputs, authority, retries, timeouts and compensation.
Compiler/runtime share the same versioned IR contract.
DSL cannot express undeclared privilege or bypass policy.
Parsing/versioning errors fail with precise diagnostics.
Compilation is deterministic for identical source/version.
Reject missing capabilities, cycles and invalid compensation before runtime.
In-flight operations retain the workflow version they started with unless explicit migration occurs.
Migration declares state mapping and irreversible transformations.
Unmigratable runs remain pinned or explicitly terminated/restarted.
Task type drives default policy/budgets/tests but cannot grant privilege.
Unknown tasks use conservative generic classification.
Underestimation cannot bypass hard limits; runtime can revise estimate.
Detect over-decomposition, cycles and missing integration step.
Use real dependency/state data rather than narrative estimates alone.
Schedulers respect hard dependencies/leases/authority before optimization.
Algorithm choice is measurable and replaceable.
Simulation is non-authoritative and labels assumptions.
Controllers cannot exceed policy/authority or resource bounds.
Stability/oscillation behavior is evaluated before production use.
Level changes are policy decisions, not model self-assessment.
Each level maps to mandatory human controls/evidence.
Escalation requires explicit eligibility and approval policy.
De-escalation propagates to active child work/tool grants promptly.
Preserve recoverable checkpoints/evidence while stopping effects.
